bio.text: Geraldo Reyes Jr. has represented the 75th Assembly District of Waterbury in the Connecticut House of Representatives since 2016, and is a Deputy Speaker.
He is a manufacturing engineer who spent 36 years in the industry.
He has been president of the South End Neighborhood Association since 2015 and a district leader on the Democratic Town Committee.
He serves on the Appropriations, Environment and Transportation committees.
